summary: Configured and verified a persistent three-node Patroni/PostgreSQL HA cluster routed through node1. node2 is the single writable primary; node3 and node4 stream replicated appdb data.
actions_performed: Configured and saved VyOS LAN routing and HA-only firewall rules.
Added persistent routed-LAN addresses and host routes.
Installed and configured a three-member etcd quorum.
Configured Patroni with synchronous standby quorum, automatic failover, pg_rewind, and recovery rejoin.
Created appdb and appuser; verified committed data locally on both replicas.
Enabled etcd and Patroni for reboot persistence; disabled standalone PostgreSQL startup.
